_doc: ADR-0100 D-C (grill-t39 D-002): the Drift-Declaration Registry (漂移声明注册表) - a registered line-level drift declaration (登记的行级漂移声明) consumed by the rewrite-map classifier as a declared fact on the INPUT side, never as an exemption branch inside a judging leg. Append-only: entries are never edited or deleted, supersession is a newer registered_at entry. registered_at replaces expires_at (no TTL, no auto-lapse - a registered historical fact does not lapse). Each entry names the overwriting source commit and carries the restored line verbatim, because an entry that names only a gap is a claim while an entry carrying the lost bytes is evidence. Gate-close (ADR-0100 D-D): any entry added after this file's own add-commit is a red-level signal - the anchor is derived from history, never stored here. Wording law (ADR-0093 D-4): 豁免/waiver vocabulary is forbidden and machine-checked. Self-citation exempt from the doc-citation scan alongside docs/rewrite-map.json and docs/governance/orphan-cites.json: the hex literals below are payload fields, not claims.
